source: Pinned exchange-calendars 4.13.2 through the real worker; no HTTP feed or replay fixture.
semantics: Modeled regular-session open/close instants. No observed trades, real-time halts, extended hours or guarantees of venue availability.

synthetic_event_controls: Two invented instants exactly at the first selected shared interval start/end verify half-open membership.
